question: what is HT-4
answer:
**HT-4 — Residential apartments and colonies (HT)** (booklet page 38)

Residential apartments and colonies (inside or outside the premises of the main HT installation) availing power supply independently or by tapping the main HT line; power may be used for residences, theatres, shopping facility, club, hospital, guest house, yard / street lighting, canteen within the colony; temples, churches, mosques, gurudwaras, ashrams, mutts and religious / charitable institutions using power for religious activities; jails & prisons.

| Component | FY 2025-26 | FY 2026-27 | FY 2027-28 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Demand charge | ₹290 per kVA per month of billing demand | ₹290 per kVA per month of billing demand | ₹290 per kVA per month of billing demand |
| Energy charge | 690 paise per unit (kWh) | 700 paise per unit (kWh) | 715 paise per unit (kWh) |

- Colonies tapping the main HT supply, metered at a single point, are billed at this rate; no reduction in the recorded demand of the main HT supply.
- Commercial use inside colonies (canteens, clubs, shops, auditorium) is allowed if it is less than 10% of the contract demand.
- Residential apartments: commercial use (shops, hotels) is billed under the appropriate schedule (energy charges only), deducted from the main HT bill; common areas are billed at the tariff of the predominant consumer category. Common areas = water pumping, lift, motor, parking lighting, sewage treatment plant, firefighting, swimming pool, gym, clubhouse - for bona fide use only, never commercial.
- Religious / charitable institutions on HT: kalyana mantapa / marriage hall / restaurant / other commercial use is billed under HT-2(b) energy charges through a sub-meter, deducted from the main meter; no reduction in demand charges.

Source: CESC tariff booklet FY2025-26 to FY2027-28 (KERC Tariff Order 2025 dated 27.03.2025). CESC with other ESCOMs filed Review Petition No. 08/2025 before KERC seeking revision of tariff for LT-4(a), LT & HT industries and commercial categories; the booklet's rates are subject to the outcome.
